purpose: One fixed lightweight text reranker comparison; current Qwen main choice retained independently of these results.

model.implementation: transformers.AutoModelForSequenceClassification; raw logits, no sigmoid or 0–4 mapping

runtime.truncation_policy: No silent truncation: measure untruncated token length before scoring and fail if any exceeds 8192.
runtime.schedule: Run only after Qwen development batch completes; keep existing Qwen server resident.

data_use: Previously exposed validation/development and validation/confirmation only; no Test inputs. Both role settings fixed before any BGE inference. Confirmation is an auxiliary fixed-baseline comparison, not a new untouched confirmation set.

evaluation.l1: Raw score pair preference; same official and development human-v5 populations as Qwen.
evaluation.primary_tie_break: fixed fusion score then chunk_id; tail unchanged
evaluation.main_method_choice: Qwen unchanged; no selection on these results.

constraints: Use existing fixed candidate pools and visible text only.
No training, recall, prompt changes, model sweep or Test.
Keep raw real-valued BGE scores outside the 0–4 LLM cache; use existing l2_rankers/evaluate_pairs/evaluate_rankers directly.
